primitives.name: Pose Estimation Latency Optimization
primitives.verbatim_quote: Experiments comparing BlazePose, OpenPose, and MoveNet revealed BlazePose's superior latency (28ms) and accuracy over the other two, validating its efficiency with Sentis.
primitives.assumptions: Latency is measured in milliseconds; accuracy is evaluated via joint position error; Sentis enables native ONNX model execution in Unity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Latency exceeds 50ms or accuracy drops below 90%.

layer2.mapping: BlazePose's optimized ONNX model runs via Unity Sentis, enabling sub-30ms pose estimation for real-time avatar synchronization.
layer2.telemetry: Average pose estimation latency (ms), joint position RMSE

primitives.name: Avatar Motion Synthesis
primitives.verbatim_quote: Utilizing BlazePose and Unity Sentis, the system tracks player movements via webcam, translating them into a 3D avatar for interactive drills against a virtual ball dispenser [3].
primitives.assumptions: Webcam captures full-body pose; 3D avatar mirrors motion with minimal delay; virtual ball dispenser operates under deterministic physics.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Motion lag exceeds 100ms or avatar misalignment > 5cm.

layer2.mapping: Player body kinematics map to avatar joints via affine transformation; motion synthesis preserves spatial and temporal integrity.
layer2.telemetry: Joint angle deviation (degrees), motion synchronization delay (ms)

primitives.name: Indoor Training Accessibility
primitives.verbatim_quote: This accessible, desktop-based solution outperforms traditional methods by eliminating environmental dependencies and reducing costs.
primitives.assumptions: Desktop environment supports webcam input; no multi-camera setup required; cost per user is less than $100.
primitives.breakdown_regime: System fails to operate with single webcam or exceeds $100 cost threshold.

layer2.mapping: Single-webcam architecture reduces deployment complexity and cost, enabling scalable indoor training across diverse environments.
layer2.telemetry: Deployment cost ($), number of supported users, environmental dependency count
